task.title: Stabilize session handoff orchestration
task.summary: Research and fix Pi session handoff orchestration so fresh-context handoffs, context resets, and artifact wait/release flows do not block agents or require user-facing command dispatch.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki handoff orchestration is recoverable and adapter-managed: no user-facing handoff command burden, no hidden compaction result loss, clear fresh-session semantics, and artifact waiters have a wake/resume path.
acceptance: Accepted handoff recovery feedback build is preserved and linked in task evidence.
Pi handoff behavior is grounded in current Pi docs/examples/API, including `ctx.newSession`, `withSession`, `sendUserMessage`, compaction, and session replacement limits.
Context-reset handoffs do not auto-queue immediate compaction from tool context and preserve visible tool results.
New-session handoffs either use `ctx.newSession({ withSession })` safely inside command context or a documented fallback when true new terminal tab/process is not available through Pi extension APIs.
The handoff command is no longer required as a user-facing recovery step; tool/adapter behavior must hide or internalize it where possible, with explicit fallback only when Pi API cannot do more.
Artifact wait/release records enough ready/wake evidence for waiting sessions to discover and resume when blockers release, without busy polling or hidden user commands.
KB/API docs define required handoff points and when to use fresh session, context reset, external orchestrator, or no handoff.
non_goals: Do not resume TASK-001 until handoff blocker path is stable enough for validation/implementation loops.
Do not claim terminal-tab support unless Pi exposes an API or safe external process path is implemented.
Do not weaken CodeWiki traceability, artifact status, or fresh validation requirements.
verification: Run CodeWiki alignment, stale-reference, generated-parity, file-structure, and changed audits.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from source refs and build handoffs, not prior loop chat memory.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Context-reset handoffs do not auto-queue immediate compaction from tool context and preserve visible tool results.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: New-session handoffs either use ctx.newSession({ withSession }) safely inside command context or a documented fallback when true new terminal tab/process is not available through Pi extension APIs.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: runSessionHandoffCommand continues to use ctx.newSession({ setup, withSession }) and tests assert kickoff prompt is sent through replacement context. KB docs document no Pi portable terminal-tab API and require external-orchestrator/worker path for true separate process.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: The handoff command is no longer required as a user-facing recovery step where possible.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Queued new-session tool result hides the command text when auto-queued, returns terminate=true to stop stale old-session continuation, and docs mark /wiki-session-handoff as compatibility executor not user workflow surface. Context-reset remains staged rather than hidden-compacting.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Artifact wait/release records enough ready/wake evidence for waiting sessions to discover and resume when blockers release.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/application/claims.ts adds readyWaitersForSession; src/adapters/pi/artifact-wake.ts watches the CodeWiki session queue, records codewiki_artifact_wait_wake custom entries, sets status, and injects bounded follow-up wake messages for ready waits. tests/smoke/claim-wait-queue.test.mjs covers ready helper and wake notification behavior.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: KB/API docs define required handoff points and modes.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: api.md, adapters.md, change-lifecycle.md, and validation-gateway.md document wait wake, Pi adapter constraints, chat-as-continuity source-of-truth model, and handoff policy points.

closure_brief.user_intent: Recover blocked session handoff work and stabilize /wiki-session-handoff orchestration so agents are not blocked by user-facing command dispatch, hidden compaction, missing wait wake, or unclear fresh-context policy.
implemented_changes: Preserved accepted handoff recovery feedback/documentation/planning builds.
Documented Pi ctx.newSession as current-terminal replacement and no portable terminal-tab API.
Kept context-reset from auto-queueing hidden compaction.
Internalized queued new-session handoff output where possible and terminates old tool turn after queueing.
Added artifact wait ready helper and Pi wait wake watcher/message path.
Defined handoff policy in validation gateway docs.
Updated focused smoke tests for handoff and wait wake behavior.
acceptance_evidence: See acceptance_mapping entries for HND/TASK-006 criteria.
checks: codewiki_audit profiles=[alignment,stale-reference,generated-parity,file-structure,changed]: warning only for generated changed files
non_goals_preserved: Did not implement terminal-specific launcher without design/config.
Did not weaken validation fresh-context/content-proof gates.
Did not resume TASK-001 before stabilizing handoff blocker.
remaining_risks: Fresh implementation validation still needs a reliable independent context or worker; current session can produce builder evidence only.

risks: Some Pi transcripts may still show the internally queued compatibility command because Pi command dispatch is slash-command based.
Artifact wake uses fs.watch; adapters without reliable filesystem notifications should implement equivalent RPC/event wake transport.
